ipv4_forwarding_egress_byte_hops.definition: Sum of IPv4 forwarding-rule counters with physical output ports. Each traversal across a switch egress contributes bytes, so transit traffic is counted once per hop; this is a network-load proxy, not unique end-to-end bytes or application payload bytes.

global_host_link_at_s2_port5.scope_note: These are OpenFlow forwarding counters for model-update transport and its TCP/application responses. The current runner does not transmit the global model down to clients over Mininet, so these are not a complete accounting of all possible federated-learning communication.

raw_switch_flow_counter_sums_including_n.warning: These raw sums can include non-forwarding flow entries and duplicate transit traffic; do not report them as unique bytes or payload bytes. Use ipv4_forwarding_egress_byte_hops for the forwarding-load proxy.

transport: Mininet TCP client-to-edge and edge-to-global using bounded JSON/tensor framing
note: Training is orchestrated by the runner, but all model-update messages traverse Mininet host namespaces. The s2 port-5 counters uniquely measure traffic crossing the global host link. Summed per-switch byte counters are byte-hops and are not unique bytes.
